## Change

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List checks run and any limitations. For behavior changes, include a meaningful
regression test. For documentation, check commands and relative links.

- [ ] No private books, credentials, or account-specific files are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, including Pandoc checks when EPUB behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation and MANIFEST.sha256 match the change.
